title: Divisionsmatch rulebook
description: One version of the rules for the Danish divisionsmatch. The program reads this file and uses its values for each calculation.

version.description: The name of the rules version, for example "2025". For a file in the rulebooks folder, the file name must be this name plus ".yml".

name.description: A name for people to read.

source.description: The basis for the values in this file, for example a web address.

match_points.description: The match points that a club gets for one match.

win.description: The match points for a win. Must be more than the points for a loss.

draw.description: The match points for a draw. Must be from the loss points to the win points.

loss.description: The match points for a loss.

club_limit.description: The share of a scale that one club can score with. With 0.5 and a scale of 8 places, one club can score with 4 runners at most.

walkover.description: The rule for a match where one club did not come to the competition.

score_share.description: The club that came gets the match points for a win. Its score is its own score multiplied by this share.

tie_breaks.description: The order of the tie-breaks for clubs with the same match points.

items.description: mutual_score: the score in the matches between these clubs. best_runners: the number of groups where the club has the best runner among these clubs, then the second best runner, and so on.

class_names.description: How the program finds the group of a class from the class name.

same_group_suffixes.description: A class name with one of these endings is the same group as the name without the ending. With "A", the class "H21A" is in group H21.

groups.description: The groups, in the order that a result shows them.

name.description: The group name in the rules, for example "H21".

scale.description: The points for the scoring runners, in finish order. The first number is for the fastest scoring runner.

aliases.description: Other class names for the same group, for example "Beg" for Begynder.
